Alger, 13 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 13, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The digital platform temtem announces it has redistributed 360 million dinars to its users since the launch of its cashback offering in January 2025. The system allows consumers to recover a portion of their expenses by scanning their receipt tickets.
Restitution financière et fonctionnement: Financial restitution and operation of the system
La plateforme temtem a atteint un total: The temtem platform has reached a total of three hundred and sixty million dinars paid back to its community since the introduction of its cashback service in January two thousand and twenty-five. The principle relies on scanning receipt tickets via the mobile application for the purchase of fast-moving consumer goods.
Le catalogue compte actuellement plus de: The catalog currently features more than seventy eligible references, offering a financial return of up to ten dinars per item. The overall volumes processed reflect an average of approximately fifty-one dinars refunded per digitized receipt. The accumulated funds can then be used for mobile top-ups, purchases on the company's marketplace, or payments at partner locations via QR code.
Le système de remboursement s'accompagne: The cashback system is accompanied by other promotional features, such as a digital wheel of fortune accessible after scanning a receipt containing an eligible product. Electronic equipment and trips are among the prizes at stake.
Des cartes de fidélité numériques permet: Digital loyalty cards also make it possible to gather purchases by partner brand to obtain benefits. A specific agreement with Djezzy Student Campuce further offers a double cashback on certain products intended for students.
